title: Birds of a Feather
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about a flock. Five birds fly in a V over Kit and keep that shape the whole way, because they share one path and one speed. In the second room two of them are faster, and the V comes apart. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a bird's speed.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie crosses two short rooms under a flock of five birds. They fly in a V and hold it, because every bird has the same path and speed. Give two of them more speed and the V comes apart. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a bird's speed.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Monsters that share a path keep their shape
Made to be copied and taken apart
